summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with strong embedded systems and firmware experience on ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers. Built bare-metal embedded C firmware with a low-level I2C device driver and interrupt-driven ADC capture, and ran FreeRTOS RTOS tasks with mutex coordination on STM32. Debugged and integrated multi-device wireless and networked systems (Bluetooth, WebSocket, static IP networking) in C/C++.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.
Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI-based real-time chroma keying without a green screen; produced full claims documentation and BOM.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.

Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (Type=simple, auto-restart with backoff, non-root user/group isolation, environment-file-based config) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device WebSocket registration; configured XRDP for remote desktop administration of the headless Jetson.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles — a 4-bit A/B transition state machine on hardware interrupts — and drove four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM via DuePWM.

Integrated Xbox 360 control over USB Host Shield with 4x Cytron motor drivers, dual claw subsystems with per-claw IR sensing, and a catapult thrower; added a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect.
